scope: Read-only source and timing/resource metadata review; no model fitting, no code mutation, no training-score inspection.
finding: Every new Stage A child redundantly performs full acceptance of every prior successful stage job twice before its own preflight and attempt-start record. This gives quadratic batch-level verification count.

call_paths.action: Controller spawns one fresh run.execute child and measures complete child subprocess lifetime.
Full sealed runtime/input/prepared-graph/initial file SHA validation once when entering child.
For a new job, each earlier stage job receives full acceptance.
After acquiring training lock, every plan job with a started record is fully checked again for incomplete failure latches.
All frozen runtime/input/prepared graph/initial SHA checks run again before current preflight.
Preflight runs before attempt.started timestamp is written.
Current fit independently receives child-end and parent acceptance checks.
Whole selected stage accepted again after all jobs finish; later explicit verify/interim also verify the selected stage.

full_attempt_verification_work: Hash every receipt artifact, including best.pt and last.pt (run.py:516-520).
Read and hash resource samples, parse them, and validate all samples/local timing evidence (resource_plan.py:196-262).
Load both best/last checkpoint payloads on CPU and recompute tensor digests (run.py:567-579).
Reload graph and validate identities independently for inner_val and outer_test (run.py:443-477,582-584).
Internally recompute metric equality for integrity; this audit never inspected or emitted those scores (run.py:581-588).

count_analysis.assumptions: Fresh uninterrupted 60-job Stage A; one authorized child per job; no reused or failed jobs.
not_in_3540: Controller startup verification when resuming an invocation
count_analysis.growth: Per-new-job prior-results verification count is linear in completed jobs; total prior-results verification work is quadratic in stage size.

timing_definitions.child_total_seconds: batch.py:299-305 subprocess wall time; includes imports, prior-results checks, preflight, model assembly, fit, validation, checkpoint/export and child-end verification; excludes parent acceptance.
timing_definitions.child_start_to_attempt_started_seconds: attempt.started_unix minus subprocess start. Includes imports, twice prior-result acceptance, twice plan validation, lock acquisition and preflight; model construction/fit not yet started.
timing_definitions.attempt_started_to_context_file_mtime_se: Includes prepared/initial loading and environment checks plus CUDA context initialization and writing context JSON; not pure CUDA-init time.
timing_definitions.child_end_to_acceptance_file_mtime_secon: Approximation to parent acceptance elapsed from subprocess completion to acceptance JSON mtime; includes small metadata overhead and relies on filesystem wall-clock mtimes.

interpretation_limits: The rising pre-attempt interval and the deterministic two prior-job scans corroborate increasing orchestration/verification cost, not high GPU-training cost.
No per-function timer exists in these records: the entire pre-attempt interval cannot be attributed numerically to authorize_job, the second pass, hashing, or CPU checkpoint load individually.
Filesystem cache, CPU load, disk load and process startup also affect elapsed time.
The sampled context-file mtime intervals are not pure GPU initialization measurements.
No training/history log was read; this audit does not independently time the first epoch or estimate pure fit speed.
Hash/checkpoint/graph validation is substantially different work from writing a short progress text line.
This evidence does not diagnose CUDA spilling/OOM and does not prove correctness failures or numerical changes.
batch_policy: Keep Stage A code, sealed plan, authorization, validation gates and serial execution unchanged. Do not bypass repeated checks during this batch.
possible_followup_after_stage_A_user_rev: Report fit/epoch timing separately from subprocess and controller wall time.
Design an integrity-preserving acceptance reuse mechanism or consolidate duplicate same-child full checks; validate tamper/failure/resume detection before any new sealed batch.
Add explicit timers around plan validation, prior-job validation, model assembly, fit, export and final verification in a later authorized change.
Do not promise an exact speedup until those phases have been separately measured.
